name: Mediterranean Bean Bowl
ingredients: 1½ cups mixed cooked beans (chickpeas, white beans, kidney beans)
100 g firm tofu or 60 g low-fat feta, cubed
¼ cup parsley and mint, chopped
Dressing: 2 tsp olive oil, juice of 1 lemon, 1 tsp dried oregano, salt, pepper
steps: Whisk the dressing in a large bowl.
Add the beans, cucumber, tomatoes, onion and olives.
Fold in the tofu or feta.
Add the herbs, toss, and rest for 10 minutes before serving.
note: Using three kinds of beans gives a wider mix of fibre and amino acids; olives are salty so no extra salt is needed.
